aboutH2: Rose City Recovery: Private Addiction Treatment in Welland, Ontario
intro: Rose City Recovery is a trusted addiction treatment center located in Welland, Ontario, committed to helping individuals overcome substance use disorders and mental health challenges through compassionate, evidence-based care. Our mission is simple but powerful, to support long-term recovery by treating the whole person, not just the addiction.

At Rose City Recovery, we offer a full continuum of care designed to meet clients exactly where they are in their recovery journey. Our programs include non-medical, supported detox, structured residential treatment, and flexible outpatient services. Each program is carefully tailored to the individual, recognizing that no two recovery paths are the same. By combining clinical expertise with personalized treatment planning, we create meaningful, sustainable outcomes for our clients.

pillars.title: A Century-Old Home Near Chippawa Park
pillars.body: Rose City Recovery runs out of a century-old house at 371 Niagara Street in Welland, a short walk from Chippawa Park, one of the largest parks in Niagara. Inside, it looks and feels like a family home. There is a living room with a brick fireplace, a dining room where residents share chef-prepared meals, a boardroom, a laundry room and an outdoor social area out back where smoking and vaping are allowed. Every client has a private bedroom. The house takes no more than eight clients at a time, and staff are awake on site 24 hours a day.

pillars.title: Planning the Return Home
pillars.body: Discharge planning and case management come with every stay, and families take part while their relative is still in residence. The longer the program, the more time goes into getting ready to go home. The 90-day stay adds reintegration planning that covers work and housing, along with life skills and practice using new coping tools in real situations. Aftercare options on this listing include in-person follow-up sessions, family follow-up counselling, a recovery coach and support meetings. Recovery.com describes the centre's aftercare as lifetime, with ongoing counsellor meetings, job support and an alumni group, so ask admissions what comes with your program.

pillars.title: Started by People With Lived Experience
pillars.body: The centre says its founders came to this work through lived experience. They had seen programs that felt cold, overcrowded or one-size-fits-all, and set out to build a place in Welland that feels like home. Rose City does not publish staff names, though its FAQ does describe the team. Therapists and counsellors hold relevant degrees and are registered with their professional colleges. Support staff are trained in first aid and CPR, crisis intervention and trauma-informed care. A doctor is available virtually at any hour and in person when needed, and staff are trained to use naloxone in an overdose.

overview: Our approach is rooted in evidence-based therapies while also embracing holistic methods that support mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Treatment may include individual counseling, group therapy, trauma-informed care, relapse prevention strategies, and wellness-focused practices that help clients rebuild confidence and resilience. This balanced approach allows us to address underlying issues while equipping individuals with practical tools for real life beyond treatment.

What truly sets Rose City Recovery apart is our dedicated team of experienced professionals. Our clinicians, support staff, and recovery specialists are deeply committed to creating a safe, respectful, and nurturing environment. We believe healing happens best when people feel understood, supported, and empowered. Every client is treated with dignity, compassion, and genuine care from the moment they walk through our doors.

We work closely with clients and their families to foster accountability, encourage growth, and support long-term success. Our goal is not just sobriety, but a healthier, more fulfilling future built on stability, self-awareness, and hope.

At Rose City Recovery, recovery is not a destination, it is a journey we walk together. We are proud to help individuals reclaim their lives and move forward with confidence, purpose, and renewed strength.

location.heading: Rose City Recovery in Welland, Ontario
location.intro: Rose City Recovery is at 371 Niagara Street in Welland, in the middle of the Niagara Region, in a century-old house a short walk from Chippawa Park. Toronto is about an hour and a half away by car along the QEW and Highway 406, St. Catharines and Thorold are about 20 minutes north, Port Colborne is about 15 minutes south, and Niagara Falls is roughly 25 minutes east.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Rose City Recovery cost?
faqs.a: Rose City Recovery's pricing page lists $18,000 for 30 days, $33,000 for 60 days and $45,000 for 90 days, in Canadian dollars. Each stay includes detox support, a private room, chef-prepared meals, daily group therapy, individual counselling and doctor appointments. The centre says prices can change without notice, so confirm the current rate when you call.

Residential programs run for 30, 60 or 90 days. The 30-day stay is about stabilizing and building a routine. The 60-day program adds trauma work, family integration and at least two individual sessions a week, and the 90-day program adds reintegration planning for work and housing.

faqs.q: Does Rose City Recovery offer detox?
faqs.a: Yes, every program includes non-medical detox support to keep you safe and comfortable through withdrawal. It is not a hospital detox, and for severe medical cases the centre may arrange stabilization at a local hospital first. A doctor is available virtually 24/7, and clients on Suboxone or methadone are accepted, with the team working alongside their prescriber.

faqs.q: What types of addiction treatment programs does Rose City Recovery offer?
faqs.a: Rose City Recovery offers a full continuum of care to support individuals at different stages of recovery. Programs include non-medical, supported detox, residential inpatient treatment, and outpatient services. Each program is designed to address both substance use disorders and co-occurring mental health conditions, ensuring clients receive well-rounded, effective care based on their specific needs.

faqs.q: Where is Rose City Recovery and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 371 Niagara Street in Welland, in Ontario's Niagara Region, close to Chippawa Park. From Toronto it is about an hour and a half by car along the QEW and Highway 406, and St. Catharines is about 20 minutes away. Call 1-647-495-9975 before you travel so the team can plan your arrival.

faqs.q: Is this a private centre? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, Rose City Recovery is a private centre with no OHIP funding, so OHIP will not pay for a stay. Many clients use workplace or private extended health benefits, and the centre suggests asking your insurer about coverage for residential treatment for substance use or inpatient mental health services. Admissions can provide cost breakdowns and fill in insurance forms, and financing is available through Medicard.

faqs.q: How quickly can I be admitted?
faqs.a: Usually within 24 hours to a few days, depending on availability, since there is no public waitlist. Bring about a week of comfortable clothes, alcohol-free toiletries, valid ID, your health card and your current medications in unopened bottles. Phones and laptops are generally left at home.

Every stay includes discharge planning and case management, and the 90-day program adds planning for work and housing. Aftercare listed for the centre includes in-person follow-up sessions, family follow-up counselling, a recovery coach and support meetings. Ask admissions which follow-up comes with your program.

faqs.q: How is treatment personalized for each client?
faqs.a: Treatment at Rose City Recovery is never one-size-fits-all. Every client receives an individualized treatment plan developed after a comprehensive assessment. This plan considers substance use history, mental health concerns, personal goals, and life circumstances. Therapies and services are adjusted as clients progress, allowing care to evolve alongside their recovery journey.

faqs.q: What therapies and treatment approaches are used?
faqs.a: Rose City Recovery focuses on evidence-based therapies combined with holistic approaches. Treatment may include individual counseling, group therapy, cognitive behavioral therapy, relapse prevention planning, and trauma-informed care. Holistic elements are also incorporated to support emotional balance, stress management, and overall well-being, helping clients build a strong foundation for lasting recovery.

faqs.q: Is mental health treatment available alongside addiction care?
faqs.a: Yes, mental health support is a core part of treatment at Rose City Recovery. Many individuals struggle with co-occurring mental health conditions such as anxiety, depression, or trauma. The clinical team is experienced in treating both substance use disorders and mental health challenges together, which is essential for long-term recovery and stability.

faqs.q: What makes Rose City Recovery different from other treatment centers in Ontario?
faqs.a: Rose City Recovery stands out for its personalized approach, experienced clinical team, and commitment to creating a safe, supportive environment. Located in Welland, Ontario, the center combines professional medical care with compassion and respect, focusing not only on sobriety but on helping clients rebuild confidence, life skills, and a meaningful future beyond treatment.
